text: The beautiful interface, simple & intuitive design, and insightful stats are fantastic but the icing on the cake for me was the web version!!! I'm not glued to my phone (or my tablet) but I am almost always at my PC, during the work day especially. The more habits you track, the more interesting your board becomes! Would love a few more color options but the limited colors are not at all a problem, the hues are really where it's at. As you build the habit the hue becomes darker. The stronger the hue, the stronger the habit! And ... a fun feature of this app is the BREAK A HABIT setting, where the hue gets lighter as you break the habit, how fun is that!? So you can have ascending & descending color rows that add visual interest to your board! When I find myself tempted to not do a habit I'm trying to build, I find myself not wanting to break the colors, which helps me do the habit! Hook, line, and sinker, this app is truly effective at helping build habits (or break bad ones). My only feedback was for the web version, to "freeze" the top row so that the dates stay put even if you have to scroll thru the habits. Joan was responsive to that feedback. Great work, great app! Thanks Joan!
